primary_task: Generate a spoken audio clip (e.g. a demo narration) from user text by running the bundled CLI scripts/text_to_speech.py against the OpenAI Audio API with a built-in voice.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.evidence: "`OPENAI_API_KEY` must be set for live API calls." ; "Require `OPENAI_API_KEY` before any live API call."
requirements.basis: "There are no accounts or credentials for other external services." ; lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)"

requirements.name: api.openai.com
requirements.evidence: "batch speech generation via the OpenAI Audio API" ; "Use the OpenAI Python SDK (`openai` package) for all API calls"
requirements.basis: "Network egress goes through an allow-list proxy: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA)."

requirements.name: openai (Python package)
requirements.evidence: "uv pip install openai" / "python3 -m pip install openai"
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

requirements.name: bundled CLI scripts/text_to_speech.py
requirements.evidence: "Run the bundled CLI (`scripts/text_to_speech.py`) with sensible defaults" ; "Never modify `scripts/text_to_speech.py`. If something is missing, ask the user before doing anything else."
